episodes.title: Interview with Michael S. Black, exposing the cult of Gwen Shamlin & Remnant Fellowship
episodes.description:
In recent years, there's been a growing interest in the controversial figure of Cult leader Gwen Shamlin and her church, Remnant Fellowship. 

In this podcast, we'll explore the rise and fall of Gwen Shamlin's influence, the inner workings of her church, and the impact it has had on its members. 

Michael Shamblin Black, the son of Gwen Shamlin, shares insider insights that shed light on this Cult, and the damage that the Remnant Fellowship still causes. 

Michael Shamblin Black provides a personal perspective on his mother’s transformation from a respected leader to a figure of controversy. He recalls how the Weigh Down Workshop attracted thousands, particularly women, who were searching for spiritual guidance in their weight loss journeys. However, this initial focus on faith and self-improvement gradually shifted towards a more controlling and narcissistic leadership style. And how it has created a religious culture of body shaming and anorexia.
